deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 34% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.9% = 10-year Treasury 4.9% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 24% last year; 27%/yr over 3 years — the market expects faster growth than the company has recently delivered.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: -14% — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $-14 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 1% (3 years ago -5%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $10.7B, up 49% from a year ago — about 2.0× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $4.8B, up 26% from a year ago.

deeper.title: Earnings-quality red flags
flags: Stock-based pay is 23% of sales — a real cost to shareholders that cash-flow figures leave out.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 27%/yr over 3 years and 37%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today -2% vs a 5-year range of -10–1% (median -6%): in the middle of its range.
deeper.margin_position: in the middle of its range

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: No buybacks or dividends reported over the last 12 months. Share count up 4.5% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $1.61, down 1% in 90 days; 3 analysts raised, 0 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $1.26, down 2% in 90 days; 2 analysts raised, 0 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +35% vs a year ago · $0.06 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 35% vs sales 26% (latest quarter vs a year earlier): profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 8 quarters running, but the beats are shrinking (14% → 3%): the bar is getting harder to clear.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.sub: latest quarter +26% vs a year earlier · 12-month sales $5.4B
tiles.read: Latest quarter: sales up 26% vs a year earlier, about as fast as two quarters ago (23%): steady demand.
tiles.explain: Headline: sales over the last 12 months vs the 12 months before. Bars: each quarter's sales vs the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Operating margin -2%: it spends more to run the business than it earns from sales.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: It turned 2752% of its reported profit into spare cash: the profits are real money, not just accounting.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 3954× last year's profit (higher than 75% of the last 5 years); only 140× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Dec 1; analysts expect EPS of $0.31, up 30% from a year ago. It usually moves about 6% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.
